parameters.name: num_entities
parameters.description: Common number of factories and locations; index set size for factories and locations.

parameters.name: transport_volume
parameters.description: Transportation volume between factory $i$ and factory $j$ for all ordered factory pairs.

parameters.name: unit_transport_cost
parameters.description: Unit transportation cost from location $p$ to location $q$ for all ordered location pairs.

variables.name: assignment_matrix
variables.description: Binary assignment matrix where $x_{ip}=1$ if factory $i$ is assigned to location $p$, and $0$ otherwise.

variables.name: assignment_vector
variables.description: Integer assignment vector where $\pi_i$ is the location assigned to factory $i$.

variables.name: total_transportation_cost
variables.description: Total transportation cost achieved by the assignment.

auxiliary_variables.name: assignment_pair_product
auxiliary_variables.description: Auxiliary binary variable where y_{ijpq}=1 if factory i is assigned to location p and factory j is assigned to location q; used to linearize the quadratic transportation cost term.

constraints.name: positive_num_entities
constraints.description: The number of factories and locations must be a positive integer

constraints.name: index_domain_bounds
constraints.description: Factory and location indices must lie within the valid range from zero to N minus one

constraints.name: nonnegative_transport_volume
constraints.description: Transportation volumes must be nonnegative for all valid factory pairs

constraints.name: nonnegative_unit_transport_cost
constraints.description: Unit transportation costs must be nonnegative for all valid location pairs

constraints.name: integer_assignment_vector
constraints.description: Assignment vector entries must be integer-valued and represent valid location indices

constraints.name: one_to_one_assignment
constraints.description: Each factory must be assigned to exactly one location and each location must be used by exactly one factory

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_cost
constraints.description: The total transportation cost must be nonnegative

constraints.name: assignment_cost_definition
constraints.description: The total transportation cost is determined by the chosen factory-to-location assignment together with all factory-to-factory volumes and location-to-location costs

constraints.name: one_to_one_assignment_row
constraints.description: Each factory must be assigned to exactly one location.

constraints.name: one_to_one_assignment_column
constraints.description: Each location must be used by exactly one factory.

constraints.name: assignment_vector_linking
constraints.description: Link the assignment vector to the binary assignment matrix so that \pi_i equals the unique location assigned to factory i.

constraints.name: assignment_vector_bounds
constraints.description: Each assignment vector entry must lie within the valid location index range.

constraints.name: assignment_pair_product_definition_1
constraints.description: Link each auxiliary product variable to the corresponding pair of assignment variables using a standard linearization upper bound.

constraints.name: assignment_pair_product_definition_2
constraints.description: Link each auxiliary product variable to the corresponding pair of assignment variables using a standard linearization upper bound.

constraints.name: assignment_pair_product_definition_3
constraints.description: Force the auxiliary product variable to be one when both assignment variables are one.

constraints.name: total_transport_cost_definition_linearized
constraints.description: Replace the quadratic cost definition with a linear expression using the auxiliary product variables.

objectives.name: total_transportation_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total transportation cost induced by the factory-to-location assignment

final_objective.description: Minimize the total transportation cost induced by the factory-to-location assignment, using the linearized cost variable T.
